payout_quote: Payment is based on the length of the study. Participants are paid via Virtual ClinCard at a rate of $15.00/hour for on-campus studies and $2 to $6 for remote studies. Show-up fees are a payment of $5 given to participants who show up to an active session but are dismissed without participating.
steps: Register as a participant on the Wharton Behavioral Lab site (Sona) and complete the prescreen questions
Submit the required tax form (W-8/W-9) - a valid U.S. social security number is required for payment
Sign up for posted on-campus or remote studies
Attend and complete the study session; payment is issued via Virtual ClinCard
catches: $15/hour rate applies only to on-campus studies in Philadelphia; remote studies pay just $2-$6
Requires a valid U.S. social security number and completed tax documentation to be paid
You can only participate once in any given session and may not be eligible for all sessions due to researcher specifications
Study availability is irregular - not steady work; the lab itself says it is not a substitute for a real job
On-campus studies require travel to Steinberg-Dietrich Hall in Philadelphia
biggest_catch: The real $15/hour rate only applies to in-person studies in Philadelphia - remote studies pay just $2-$6, and study slots are irregular.
eligibility: Registered WBL participant; valid U.S. SSN and tax form; eligible per study prescreen
timing: Payment via Virtual ClinCard after session completion; payment based on session length.
